class.name: WeatherMotesEffect
class.brief_description: Tiny droplets floating around the camera in fog and rain, for a [Weather] node.
class.description: Fills a box around the camera with tiny droplets that drift with the wind and swirl, so fog and rain read as countless small particles instead of one smooth wash. Volumetric fog can't show detail this fine. The motes are lit by the scene's lights, glitter in light beams and take the sky's light under clouds. Their number follows the weather's fog density and the rain. The motes wrap around inside the box, so they follow any wind at once and the box stays full. [constant Weather.QUALITY_LOW] has none; higher quality levels have more ([method get_max_motes]).

method.name: get_intensity
method.description: How many of the [method get_max_motes] motes are shown, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_max_motes
method.description: The number of motes at full fog and rain, set by the quality level.

members.member: Scales the number of motes shown.
The height of the box of motes. It sits a little below the camera.
Seconds a mote lives before it fades and a new one appears.
The fastest the motes drift with the wind, in meters per second. Faster motes streak past and read as noise.
The render layers of the motes.
Half the width of the box of motes around the camera. They fade out before its edge.
How much of the wind speed the motes drift with.
